n: Code.org Hour of AI unplugged and Our AI Code of Ethics
t: A lesson where student groups research AI ethics and write a class code of ethics.
steps: Find Lesson 5 Our AI Code of Ethics in the Code.org Hour of AI unplugged unit.
Share one AI Ethics Research Areas handout per group online.
Print or share one reflection handout per group.
Prepare a shareable class resource such as a slide deck, document, or video.
Preview the articles and videos students may use.
Run the 10 minute warm up and the 40 minute activity.
Finish with the 5 minute wrap up.
